metadata.name: Internal Link Finder
metadata.description: Analyzes article content and finds relevant internal linking opportunities from published articles
metadata.author: Adrian Goldner

input.name: article_content
input.description: The article draft content to analyze

input.name: article_topic
input.description: The main topic/keyword of the current article

input.name: published_articles_index
input.description: Path to published articles index (YAML or JSON)
input.format: articles: - title: "Article Title" url: "/blog/article-slug" topic: "Main Topic" keywords: ["keyword1", "keyword2", "keyword3"] published_date: "2025-01-15" pillar: "Pillar Name" (optional)

input.name: topic_map
input.description: Optional: Topic map for understanding topic clusters

input.name: max_suggestions
input.description: Maximum number of internal link suggestions to return

output.name: link_suggestions
output.description: Array of internal link suggestions with relevance scores
output.structure: - article_title: string - article_url: string - anchor_text_suggestions: array of strings - relevance_score: number (0-100) - placement_recommendation: string - reasoning: string

step.details: - Read published_articles_index file - Parse YAML/JSON structure - Extract all articles with metadata - If file doesn't exist, return empty suggestions with warning
- Understand topic clusters and pillars - Identify which pillar the current article belongs to - This helps prioritize cluster-internal linking
- Extract key concepts and entities mentioned - Identify section topics - Look for natural linking opportunities (questions, examples, references)

step.action: Calculate relevance scores for each published article
step.scoring-algorithm:
For each published article:
1. Semantic Relevance (0-40 points) - Check keyword overlap between articles - Analyze topic similarity - Consider mentioned concepts
2. Topic Cluster Proximity (0-25 points) - Same pillar: +25 points - Related cluster: +15 points - Different pillar: +5 points
3. Contextual Fit (0-20 points) - Article naturally mentioned in content: +20 - Related concept discussed: +15 - Tangentially related: +10 - Forced connection: +5
4. SEO Value (0-15 points) - Links to pillar page: +15 - Links to underperforming article: +10 - Links to new article (< 3 months): +5 - Links to established article: +8
TOTAL: Sum all points, cap at 100

step.guidelines:
- Use natural, contextual anchor text (not exact match keywords) - Suggest 2-4 variations per link - Prefer longer, descriptive anchors - Avoid generic anchors like "hier" or "dieser Artikel"
Examples of GOOD anchors: - "strukturierte Interview-Techniken" - "wie du authentischen Content erstellst" - "mein Guide zu SEO-Topic-Clustern"
Examples of BAD anchors: - "klick hier" - "mehr Infos" - exact keyword stuffing

step.action: Determine optimal placement for each link
step.placement-strategy:
- Early content (first 300 words): High-priority pillar links - Mid content: Related cluster articles - End content: Deep-dive resources, related topics - Sidebars/callouts: Complementary content
Avoid: - More than 2 internal links in same paragraph - Links in first sentence - Link clusters (3+ links in 100 words)

step.details: - Remove suggestions below min_relevance_score - Sort by relevance score (highest first) - Limit to max_suggestions count - Ensure diversity (don't suggest 5 articles from same cluster)

step.template:
# Internal Linking Recommendations
**Article:** {article_topic} **Date:** {current_date} **Total Suggestions:** {count}
---
## 🔗 Link Suggestions (Ranked by Relevance)
{for each suggestion in link_suggestions:
### {rank}. {article_title} (Score: {relevance_score}/100)
**URL:** `{article_url}`
**Anchor Text Options:** 1. "{anchor_option_1}" 2. "{anchor_option_2}" 3. "{anchor_option_3}"
**Recommended Placement:** {placement_recommendation}
**Why this link?** {reasoning}
--- }
## 📊 Linking Strategy Summary
- **Pillar Links:** {count_pillar_links} - **Cluster Links:** {count_cluster_links} - **Related Links:** {count_related_links}
## 💡 Implementation Tips
1. Add links naturally during editing, not all at once 2. Prioritize the top 2-3 suggestions for best SEO impact 3. Update linked articles with reciprocal links when relevant 4. Check that link URLs are current and working
---
**Next Steps:** - Review suggestions - Integrate top 2-3 links into article - Update articles-index.yaml after publishing

usage-example.scenario: Find internal linking opportunities for a new SEO article
usage-example.code:
result = internal_link_finder.run( article_content: draft_article, article_topic: "Interview-basierte Content-Erstellung", published_articles_index: "bmad/cflow/data/published/articles-index.yaml", topic_map: "bmad/cflow/data/topic-maps/topic-map-master.yaml", max_suggestions: 5, min_relevance_score: 65 )
# Review top suggestions puts result.summary_report
# Integrate top 2-3 links into article integrate_links(result.link_suggestions[0..2])

best-practices.practice: Link to 2-4 internal articles per new article
Prioritize links to pillar pages for topic authority
Run this task BEFORE finalizing article for publication
Balance SEO goals with genuine reader value

task.notes: - This task can be invoked by the Content-Writer agent - Requires maintaining an up-to-date articles-index.yaml - Works best with 10+ published articles - Should be run after article draft is complete - Consider reciprocal linking in older articles
